action_description: 16-frame hit reaction with no visible source. Frame 1 stays unchanged; 2-6 recoil, 7 peaks, 8-13 recover, and 14-16 settle toward frame 1.
locked_constraints: keep the feet near the same ground line
show no attacker, projectile, text, or impact object
add no wound, gore, or permanent damage
preserve outfit, proportions, palette, equipment, and limbs
loop_constraint: The last frame must connect cleanly to frame 1 because the current game resource loops this animation.
